Pizza Sauce [BOOM 0002]

Prep: 10 minutes · Yield: 18 qt · Shelf life: 6 days

Allergen call out: None of the Top 9 allergens present.

Ingredients

  • 6 × #10 cans Crushed Tomatoes — Bianco DiNapoli
  • 150 g TILL Garlic Base [TILL008]
  • 120 g Kosher Salt
  • 25 g Basil, leaves only

Method

  1. Purée one can. Place 1 can of tomatoes in a 5-gallon Cambro. Add garlic base, kosher salt and basil. Purée thoroughly with an immersion blender.
  2. Add five cans and stir. Add the remaining 5 cans of tomatoes. Stir thoroughly with a perforated mixing paddle for 60 seconds.
  3. Package, label and rotate. Transfer to 6-quart Cambros. Label, date and rotate.

LEAN Working

Stage the 5-gallon Cambro, immersion blender, perforated mixing paddle, 6-quart Cambros and PrepWizard labels before mixing.

Before You Start

Scale garlic base, kosher salt and basil. Keep 1 can of tomatoes separate from the remaining 5.
